relations.text: MNTNが10-Kで、借入枠の相手として挙げる。7,500万ドル以上の預金・決済口座を置く義務もある
relations.text_en: MNTN's revolving credit is with Western Alliance Bank, and it must keep at least $75 million on deposit there

source.label: MNTN 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In addition, we are required to maintain no less than $75 million of our depository and operating accounts with Western Alliance Bank, subject to certain limited exceptions.
